::: {.hub-body .column-screen}
::: {.hub-wrap .hub-layout}
```{=html}
<div class="hub-sidebar" role="region" aria-label="Filter software">
  <button type="button" class="hub-filter-toggle" id="hub-filter-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="hub-filter-panel">
    <i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>Filters <span class="hub-filter-toggle-count" id="hub-filter-toggle-count"></span>
  </button>
  <div class="hub-filter-panel" id="hub-filter-panel">
    <label class="hub-search" for="hub-search-input">
      <span class="visually-hidden">Search software</span>
      <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <input id="hub-search-input" type="search" placeholder="Filter" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
    <details class="hub-facet" data-facet="domain" open>
      <summary>Domain <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" data-options="domain"></div>
    </details>
    <details class="hub-facet" data-facet="status">
      <summary>Status <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" data-options="status"></div>
    </details>
    <details class="hub-facet" data-facet="task" open>
      <summary>Task <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" data-options="task"></div>
    </details>
    <details class="hub-facet" data-facet="form" open>
      <summary>Type <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" data-options="form"></div>
    </details>
    <label class="hub-toggle" for="hub-online-only"><input id="hub-online-only" type="checkbox"> Runs online</label>
    <details class="hub-facet" data-facet="tag">
      <summary>Other tags <span class="hub-facet-selected"></span></summary>
      <div class="hub-options" data-options="tag"></div>
    </details>
  </div>
</div>
```
